rule: DOCK-3.7-03 / C19 (D474, macrev2-1289-4): a confirmed direct reset retires on a current reading only when a current window longer than 5 h (18000 s), whose reset is still ahead, began at or after the confirmation, within 60 s of clock skew, and not after now (a computed start in the future never counts). A 5-hour window never proves it. A banked reset (reset_credit) never retires this way. The widget (EngineResetEvent.restartedReading) and the cockpit (news-clock.ts newsRetired) read this same file.

cases.name: a 5-hour cycle began 30 s before the confirmation, the weekly cycle a day earlier
only the 5-hour window began after the confirmation
the weekly cycle restarted 30 s before the confirmation (clock skew)
the weekly cycle began exactly 60 s before the confirmation
the weekly cycle began 61 s before the confirmation
the weekly cycle began 4 min before the confirmation (the previous cycle)
a 6-hour window began 10 min after the confirmation
a weekly window whose computed cycle start lies after now (inconsistent reading)
a weekly cycle in progress since 4 days before the confirmation, reset ahead
a banked reset with the weekly cycle restarted
